fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd (RRVUNL) has released the official notification for the post of Junior Engineer, Junior Assistant. This recruitment was released for 2005 posts. Applications for the RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Online Form 2026 will Start from 05 August 2026, & Candidate can apply until 31 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd (RRVUNL)

RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Recruitment 2026

RRVUNL Advt No : RVUN/Rectt.-2026-27/02-03

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 04 August 2026
  • Application Start Date : 05 August 2026
  • Last Date : 31 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : 1000/-
  • SC, ST, EBC, MBC, BC, EWS : 500/
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

[adinserter block=”3″]

RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit as on 1 January 2027
  • Junior Accountant & Junior Assistant/ Commercial Assistant-II : 18-40 Years
  • Junior Engineer : 21-40 Years 
  • Age Relaxation as per RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

RRVUNL JE / Other Posts 2026 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 2005 Posts

Post Name No. of Post
Junior Engineer-I (Electrical) 727
Junior Engineer-I (Mechanical) 110
Junior Engineer-I (Civil) 32
Junior Assistant/ Commercial Assistant-II 765
Junior Accountant 371

RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Eligibility
Junior Engineer (Electrical)
  • The candidate must hold Full Time four years’ Graduation Degree in Engineering as a regular student or AMIE in Electrical/ Electrical & Electronics/ Electrical, Instrumentation & Control/ Power Systems & High Voltage/Power Electronics/ Power Engineering or equivalent from a University/Institution established by Law in India and recognized equivalent to full time Graduation Degree in Engineering by AICTE, New Delhi
Junior Engineer (Mechanical)
  • The candidate must hold Full Time four years’ Graduation Degree in Engineering as a regular student or AMIE in Mechanical/ Production/ Industrial Engineering/ Production & Industrial/ Thermal/ Mechanical & Automation/ Power Engineering or equivalent from a University/Institution established by Law in India and recognized equivalent to full time Graduation Degree in Engineering by AICTE, New Delhi.
Junior Engineer (Civil)
  • The candidate must hold Full Time four years’ Graduation Degree in Engineering as a regular student or AMIE in Structural/Civil Construction/Civil Engineering or equivalent from a University/Institution established by Law in India and recognized equivalent to full time Graduation Degree in Engineering by AICTE, New Delhi.
Junior Assistant/ Commercial Assistant-II
  • Candidates must have passed the Senior Secondary (10+2) Examination from a recognized board or equivalent and possess a valid computer qualification such as DOEACC ‘O’ Level or higher, NIELIT CCC, COPA/DPCS, Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer Applications, RSCIT, or any other equivalent computer qualification recognized by the Government.
Junior Accountant
  • Candidates must have a Graduation degree in Commerce or Business Administration, Intermediate (CA/ICWA), MBA, or M.Com. from a recognized university. Candidates must also possess a valid computer qualification such as DOEACC ‘O’ Level or higher, NIELIT CCC, COPA/DPCS, Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer Applications, RSCIT, or any other equivalent computer qualification recognized by the Government.

RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Online Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • CBT Exam
  • Typing Test (For Jr Assistant/ Commercial Assistant-II)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

RRVUNL JE / Other Posts Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://energy.rajasthan.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the RRVUNL before Last Date.
